name: Análisis de Ley de Zipf
description: Tests adherence to Zipf's law in intensity value distribución. Natural images follow Zipf's law more closely than generado por IA content.
mechanism: Ranks pixel intensity values by frequency and tests power-law fit. Natural images follow Zipf's distribución while AI images deviate.
parameters: Ranking: frequency-based, Fit: log-log linear regression
source: Zipf (1949), Human Behavior and the Principle of Least Effort
useCase: Detecting deviations from natural Zipf distribución

references.title: Zipf, G.K. (1949). Human Behavior and the Principle of Least Effort. Addison-Wesley.
Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2005). How Realistic is Photorealistic? IEEE TSP.
Field, D.J. (1987). Relations Between Statistics of Natural Images. JOSA-A.

strengths:
• Based on well-established estadístico law
• Natural images follow predictable Zipf distribución
• AI deviations from Zipf are measurable markers
• Fast computation on DCT coeficiente distribución
• Content-independent estadístico approach
limitations:
• Lower standalone discrimination precisión
• Heavy compression alters DCT distribucións
• Very simple or very complex images deviate naturally
• Some AI models produce Zipf-compliant distribucións
• Requires sufficient image size for stable statistics
